card.name: Spaces before dose numbers in oncology dosing
card.fires_on: Mostly a space or the word "the" right before a number or limit in cancer-drug dosing text, such as a space before "200 mg" or "24 months". It also fires on a few odd spots like the letter E in CTCAE.
